queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Arabic first-party discovery found the Egyptian General Survey Authority's official survey/cadastral-map mandate, digital-map request procedure, and national cadastral-register project descriptions. An official Egyptian Tax Authority page identified a Senbellawein office, but no local cadastral registry or public parcel viewer/API was evidenced. The ESA public pages were inspected anonymously; no bounded parcel request could be formed from a verified public endpoint.
